visual_argument: The floor where people stood: a robotic arm holds the pipe a floor hand used to steady, and one rack of drill pipe carries the company's stated share of its fleet, five of twenty joints banded for next year and ten for 2028.
build_risk: Frame 5 holds an articulated arm, a hanging joint, the joint in the slips and the rotary in one close view, all chassis models the kit lacks. The risk is stacked boxes and grey steel. Mitigation: castings with bolt rings and a cable loom, worn bright tool joints, die pads, a crop that leaves the plain upper casting out of frame; fallback is a tighter crop on gripper, pin and box.
distinct_from_recent: No. 69 was a dark bay lit through a dock door at last light, wide interiors of taped floor pads. No. 68 was a last light Permian well pad with a pump jack, tank battery and gauge boards. No. 67 was a floodlit weigh station and truck yard with wide spatial scenes. This deck stands on a rig floor two stories up at night under a cold flood, at arm's length and macro distance on steel machinery, with three material reliefs of floor plate, a pipe rack and a geologic section, and its accent is dusk_ember rather than dusk_gold.
